what_it_does: This paper describes a compact mm-wave (millimeter-wave—very high frequency radio) transmit/receive front-end module for 24-29 GHz operation, squeezed into just 0.22 square millimeters. The key innovation is an asymmetric Doherty power amplifier, which is a special circuit design that dynamically adjusts how it routes current and power depending on the signal strength in the moment. This clever routing lets the amplifier achieve high efficiency (good battery life) when handling real-world modulated signals like those in 5G, while the integrated receive path maintains low noise. The entire module—transmitter, receiver, and switching circuit—fits in a tiny footprint suitable for modern mobile devices.
